prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square premium painterly naturalistic monumental Mythics illustration, 1024x1024 or larger, of VENUS, the ROMAN goddess and protective MOTHER OF THE ROMAN STATE. Emblematic respectful composition, not a literal reconstruction of one ancient episode. ONE mature beautiful ADULT WOMAN with noble protective maternal expression, AUBURN braided/wavy hair, ONE head, TWO ordinary eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs. Entire standing figure including both sandalled feet inside square. She towers on Roman marble sanctuary steps above a small distant coastal settlement, low camera perspective, immense sky and architecture establish mythic grandeur. Wear a FULLY OPAQUE thick ivory Roman tunic up to neck and down to ankles, a deep BURGUNDY mantle flowing from shoulders, no transparent cloth, no cleavage, no nude forms, no erotic pose. One hand rests on her heart, the other extends a calm open blessing gesture toward an ancient bronze ALTAR BOWL in the lower foreground. From this bowl rises ONE strong tall TAPERING NATURAL ORANGE FLAME, recalling the documented favourable omen in the Pygmalion story; the flame originates from the altar fuel, never from her hands/eyes/body. DUSK atmosphere: ONE conspicuously BRIGHT EVENING STAR shines naturally in the dark violet sky above and beside her, referencing Venus guiding Aeneas in evening-star form, with only a few dim background stars. No geometric star badge, no halo or radiating beams connecting her to star. Roman sanctuary colonnade and a very distant Mediterranean harbour with two tiny ancient sailing ships provide scale and her protective guiding context; no other people or gods. Distinct darker twilight palette with glowing altar warmth, rich painterly cloth/bronze/marble textures, majestic goddess as civilizational guardian. No Greek Aphrodite sea-foam scene, no dove/myrtle/scallop shell, no cherubs, no weapon or war armour, no hearts/magic runes/energy circles, no modern movie/game/anime/comic design, no text/lettering/logos/watermark/border, no gore or nudity.
